	static int p=0,ip=0;
	static ArrayList<Integer> cuts=new ArrayList<>();

		int n=sc.nextInt();

					res+=cuts.get(i);
					count++;
				}
				else break;
			}
			System.out.println(count);
		}
	}
	public static void cut(int tab[]) {
		int res=0;
		int pp=0;
		int iip=0;
		int min=1000;
		for(int i=0;i<tab.length-1;i++) {
			if(tab[i]%2==0) pp++;
			else iip++;
			if(pp==iip) {
				cuts.add(Math.abs(tab[i+1]-tab[i]));
			}
		}
	}
}
